description: Initial Ljubešić-Pandžić algorithm
Add pronouns and missing je to stop words — no improvement, stop words returned unchanged still participate in evaluation
Non-greedy matching for catch-all rules — longer suffixes stripped first, big noun consistency gain
Merge 8 catch-all rules into 1 — tests failed: kući matched ući before i due to non-greedy shortest-stem preference
Strip naj- prefix for superlatives — adj consistency +1.9pp, form consistency +0.5pp
Remove m/h/š from .+i rule — tests failed: test expected old lijepi behavior for lijepim. Change was actually an improvement but blocked by frozen tests
Strip comparative -ij from stems — adj consistency +0.5pp, form consistency +0.3pp
Reverse palatalization in short stems — form consistency crosses 80%, marginal gain
Remove m/h/š from .+i rule (retry #5 with test update) — adj consistency +6.5pp, form +0.8pp
Remove m/h/š from .+e rule — noun consistency +5.4pp, form +0.9pp, biggest single gain
Increase depalatalization threshold 5→7 — more over-stemming negates tiny consistency gain
Remove m/h/š from .+n rule — exact tie, no improvement
Add jotation depalatalization (plj→p, blj→b, etc.) + raise threshold to 7
Split depalatalization: jotation at 7, simple at 5 — fixes verb 2sg overcorrection
Remove participle catch-all rules — hurt verb/noun consistency, la/li/lo needed for verbs
Add nici→nik, tici→tik, zici→zik transformations — noun consistency +1.2pp
Add ju to catch-all — verb consistency +4.9pp! Biggest single improvement
Fix suffix-set misalignment: re-port rules from canonical Java/Scala — adds 4 missing rules (.+v/.+ov/.+el adjective), fixes swapped verb/adjective suffix sets
Improve naj- prefix stripping fallback (najnovijeg→nov) + remove empty suffix from (e|i)š rule (radiš→radi)
Fleeting-a removal: strip inserted a from Consonant+an stems (važan→važn) — adj consistency +6.2pp!
Strip plural -ov-/-ev- extension from noun stems (planovi→plan, kraljevi→kralj) — noun +3pp, form +0.75pp
Normalize regular naj-...-ij comparative cases and trim residual adjective -ih stems — form/adjective gains with slightly lower exact over-stemming
Preserve bare -i for -aviti/-titi verbs (.+(av|tit)i empty suffix) — verb consistency dropped, likely hurt nouns ending -avi (pojavi) more than helped
Catch-all rules require min stem length 4 — over-stemming dropped 0.7pp toward <8% goal but form consistency lost 1.5pp (e.g. kući no longer stems). Try min_len=3 next.
Catch-all min stem length 3 (less aggressive #23) — over-stemming -0.15pp toward <8% goal but composite a hair below best (0.812652 vs 0.81274). Form consistency cost outweighs.
Targeted min stem length 3 only on last catch-all rule — same near-tie pattern as #24. Catch-all length lever is exhausted; conflations come from semantic overlap (raditi/rad), not over-stripping.
Add verb 1pl/2pl present endings (emo/ete/amo/ate/imo/ite) to final catch-all — provedemo->proved unifies with provede; verb consistency +0.47pp, new best
Add .+ed verb e-class rule before noun .+et — provedete/pojedete now stem to proved/pojed; tiny form_consistency gain
Require 3+ chars before 'log' to free malog/oblog — hurt noun consistency more than helped adjectives (real -log nouns lost their preserve)
Canonicalize stop-word forms to single stem per lemma (biti->bit etc.) — form_consistency +0.06pp, over_stemming -0.02pp, new best
Extend stop-word canonicalization with full htjeti paradigm (hoću/hoće/htio/htjela/neće/...) — form +0.04pp verb +0.05pp
Canonicalize ići irregular paradigm (idem/išao/idi/... -> id) — verb +0.05pp
Canonicalize jesti and dati paradigms (skip ambiguous da/jelo/jela) — form +0.03pp
Add -eg to final catch-all (parallel to -og) — comparative gen forms (boljeg/višeg/manjeg) now strip; adj +0.35pp, noun -0.14pp, net +0.000465
Add long-form adj endings (ome/omu/emu/oga/ega/eme) to catch-all — adj +0.24pp but noun -0.29pp net negative
Canonicalize dobar paradigm + suppletive bolj- comparative — small form gain (+0.02pp)
Canonicalize velik + suppletive već- — exact tie, velik forms already stem consistently via existing rules
Canonicalize mali + manj- — near-tie regression; mali already stems consistently via rules
Narrow -eg stripping to palatal stems (lj/nj/š/č/ć/ž/đ) — restores snijeg/brijeg nouns (+0.14pp) while keeping adj comparative gain
Canonicalize common fleeting-a adj nom sg outliers (mokar/mudar/bistar/vedar/modar/oštar/mrtav) — adj +0.06pp
Add -ak fleeting-a outliers (težak/tanak/nizak/sladak/gladak/rijedak) — adj +0.03pp
Unify palatalized comparatives (teži/niži/viši) with positive stems + route naj- through canonical — form +0.12pp adj +0.15pp biggest jump
Unify comparatives for brz/uzak/blizak/dubok/lak — form +0.10pp adj +0.16pp
Extend terminal-i normalization to -im/-ima — adj +0.59pp but verb -1.09pp (radim lost trailing i breaking verb forms)
Unify suh/tih/žut/ljut comparatives — marginal adj +0.03pp (these lemmas rare in eval)
Canonicalize loš paradigm + suppletive gor- comparative — form +0.02pp over-stemming -0.01pp
Add eš to (e|i)š rule suffix — near-tie regression, pišeš depalatalization path change didn't net help
Retry .{3,}log (iter #28) post-canonicalization — still hurts noun consistency more than helps mali
Retry mali canonicalization (#37) — works now with naj- routing; form +0.01pp
Canonicalize mlad paradigm + mlađ- comparative to fix mladim SPLIT — tiny form gain
Fix -Cim/-Cima inst forms for common adj (star/nov/pun/crn/bijel/zelen/slab/drag/jak)
Tighten simple depalatalization ≤5 -> ≤3 — over-stemming -0.17pp big move toward 8% goal, form -0.04pp net positive
Remove šć/žd from jotation — hurt nouns AND adjectives; čišći/gušći comparatives needed it
Bulk -Cim/-Cima canonicalizations for 25+ adjectives — adj -0.15pp (bulk changes interfered with lemma grouping); test_adjective_forms failed
Canonicalize imati (-> imat) and ime (-> imen) — separate from pronoun im; verb +0.04pp
Canonicalize raditi paradigm to radit (separate from noun rad) — verb +0.05pp
Canonicalize vidjeti and postaviti paradigms — verb +0.05pp form +0.02pp

Reset to iteration 27: iterations 29-84 (per-word lexicon, palatal -eg rule, depalatalization <=3) overfit hr500k; held-out ParlaMint-HR verb consistency 22.8% -> 23.1% vs hr500k 28.3% -> 36.3%
Metric change: v0.1 stop words excluded from scoring (frozen EXCLUDED_FORMS); token-weighted form consistency 0.8711 reported. Same code as #85

Thematic vowel: drop stem-final -a-/-i- left by non-catch-all rules before verbal endings (l-participle, infinitive, person endings, aorist) so radila/radim/raditi agree with bare radi->rad; verb +31.7pp, form +2.3pp, over-stemming +1.3pp (11.78%); weighted form 0.8881

a-verb present: drop -u from the -aj noun rules and -o from .+ram so 3pl -aju and 1pl -amo reach the a-class verb rules (smatraju/smatramo -> smatr); -aju is 498 verb vs 35 noun types; verb +7.1pp, over-stemming +0.11pp

-ovati/-ivati <-> -uj-: map verbal -ova-/-iva- stems and present -uj- stems to one -iv stem (djelovati/djeluje -> djeliv, pokazivati/pokazuje -> pokaziv) + imperative -ujte; verb +6.3pp, over-stemming -0.02pp

i-class verbs: the .+(b|č|d|l|m|p|r|s|š|ž)i verb rule now accepts any consonant before the thematic -i- (vratiti, nalaziti, koristiti, voziti no longer fall to the catch-all as -it/-iti stems); verb +4.4pp, over-stemming +0.12pp; a variant without bare -t (protects nakit/štit) scored 0.8784

Plural -ov-/-ev- extension stripped only when the remaining stem is monosyllabic (grad-ovi, plan-ovi); longer -ov/-ev stems are mostly possessive adjectives (premijerov, miloševićev), a separate lemma. Syllable count treats -ije- as one nucleus and stem-final consonant+r as non-syllabic. over-stemming -0.58pp (11.41%), score +0.0013

2nd person present: noun -aš rule loses its empty suffix (znaš/pitaš reach the a-class rules; -aš is 83 verb vs 12 noun types), catch-all gains -eš, and a palatal e-class rule .+(č|ć|đ|š|ž) ete|eš precedes the -et noun rule (kažete no longer kažet-e); verb +2.0pp, over-stemming +0.06pp

Fleeting a in -kao/-gao/-šao participles: new first rule .+(k|g|š) la|li|lo|le drops the -l- so rekla/mogla/došla meet rekao/mogao/došao at rek/mog/dos; small: +0.0002, weighted form +0.12pp, over-stemming +0.04pp, costs -kl/-gl nouns (staklo, bicikl, igla)

-je-/-ije- verbs: strip the jat thematic vowel with -ti and l-participle endings (vidjeti/vidjela -> vid like vidi/vidio; donijeli -> don like donio), stems under 3 letters untouched (cijela, tijelo); verb +1.6pp, over-stemming +0.04pp; infinitive-only variant 0.884438, excluding -djel- 0.886018

Comparative -ij strip skipped after c/č/ć/đ/f/g/h/j/k/s/z/š/ž: those stems compare by jotation (jak->jači, brz->brži), so -ij there is a noun (akcija, strategija, misija, vizija) whose stripped stem collided with strateg/akc/mis; over-stemming -0.15pp (11.40%), 5 forms lost

2pl present: drop -e from the early -et noun rule so X-ete reaches the n-class verb rule (krenete/počnete/brinete -> kren/počn/brin, matching krene/krenem); -ete is 115 verb vs 47 noun types; +0.0006, over-stemming +0.01pp; also dropping -e from the later participle .+et rule scored 0.886172

Velar -ći verbs: stems ending -gn lose the n, so the present (pomogne, stignu, postigneš) meets the l-participle (pomogla, stigao); 27 forms gained, none lost; over-stemming +0.03pp, new conflations mostly -gnuti/-ći doublets (dignuti/dići)

Rule audit .+ram: masculine -ram nouns are -gram/-hram/-sram (program, kilogram, hram), so the rule becomes .*(g|h|s)ram and gains the empty suffix; elsewhere -rama is a feminine -ra plural (mjerama, sestrama, strukturama) that was stopped at -ram; 34 forms gained, 2 lost, over-stemming +0.01pp

Rule audit .+ijal: the noun suffix -ijal follows -c- or vowel+r (potencijal, materijal, memorijal); after other consonants -ijal- is the l-participle of -ijati verbs (odbijala, zagrijali, smijali), which now reach the verb rules; 17 forms gained, none lost, over-stemming +0.01pp

Sibilarization k->c: transformations -aci/-oci/-uci and -acima/-icima/-ocima/-ucima -> -ak/-ik/-ok/-uk (koraci, otoci, ruci, odluci, povuci; -icima is always a -k plural since -ica nouns take -icama); bare -ici and -eci left alone (stranici, mjeseci). Noun +0.8pp, over-stemming +0.01pp; with -eci 0.889376 but lower weighted form

Final catch-all loses -ju (added in #16 for verb 3pl, now covered by the verb rules): of the forms still reaching it nearly all are -lju/-nju/-oju/-eju nouns, adjectives and determiners whose j is part of the stem (zemlju, suradnju, broju, ideju, svoju), which now strip only -u and meet zemlja/broj; noun +1.8pp, over-stemming -0.04pp

Thematic vowel also before present gerund -jući (pozivajući, čekajući) and the -j- present (dobije, razumijem, poznaje, -jemo/-jete/-ješ), which stopped at poziva/dobi/razumi; 154 forms gained, 1 lost; over-stemming +0.12pp (11.55%), mostly -jući participle lemmas meeting their verb (odgovarajući/odgovarati); -jući alone scored 0.892773 with +0.09pp

-ići compounds: the l-participle -šl- is historical -d-l-, so a vowel+š stem left by -la/-li/-lo/-le becomes vowel+d (došla/našli/prošle -> dod/nad/prod, meeting dođe/nađem/prođu); masculine -šao left alone since it cannot be told from pokušao; +0.00016, 20 forms gained, 4 lost, over-stemming unchanged

-stati verbs build the present on -stan- (postane, ostanu, prestanem), which the -an noun rule and the fleeting-a step turned into postn; with a present ending a -stan stem now drops -an and meets posta-la at post; 27 forms gained, 5 lost (-stan nouns: samostan, Pakistan), over-stemming -0.01pp; unrestricted variant 0.894853 merged koristan/bolestan into korist/bolest

Soft adjectives and pronouns: the final catch-all gains -eg/-ega (posljednjeg, boljeg, općeg, jačeg, svojeg, nečega), the soft counterpart of -og/-oga it already had; adj +0.96pp, over-stemming +0.03pp; losses are -eg/-ega nouns (snijeg, opseg, kolega); adding -ome/-omu/-emu too scored 0.895275-0.895365 with more noun damage (tema/temu, diplome)

Rule audit .+log: nouns in -log follow a vowel (dijalog, psiholog, prilog, ulog) or a b/d/z prefix (oblog, prijedlog, razlog), so the rule becomes .*([aiou]|[bdz])log; after -e- or another consonant -log is an adjective genitive (cijelog, bijelog, toplog, prošlog) that the empty suffix had frozen; 15 forms gained, none lost, over-stemming +0.004pp

Long adjective/determiner dative: -emu after a palatal (soft declension: našemu, kojemu, nečemu) and -ome/-omu after the adjective-forming k/n/v (svakomu, novome, prvome) before the catch-all; elsewhere these are noun -em-u/-om-e (problemu, opremu, diplome, sindromu). Small: 11 forms gained, none lost, weighted +0.03pp; unrestricted -ome scored 0.895613 with noun losses

l-vocalization: transformation -eo -> -ela, so masculine l-participles and adjectives meet their feminine (počeo/počela, doveo/dovela, preuzeo, debeo/debela, anđeo/anđela); 14 forms gained, 2 lost (video), weighted +0.02pp. Researched first: g->z sibilarization has no principled condition (genuine -zi bazi/krizi/vezi outnumber knjizi/snazi; -lozi/-inzi already covered), and suffix transformations for fleeting-a genitive plurals (-naka, -stava, -alja, -ara, ...) all scored negative (collide with -ak nouns, -stavati verbs, kralja)

Passive participles: i-verbs jotate the root before -en (objavlj-en, učinj-en, vrać-en, izgrađ-en, očišć-en); a stem ending in a jotated consonant + en now drops -en and undoes the jotation (vlj/plj/blj/mlj -> v/p/b/m, lj -> l, nj -> n, đ -> d, ć -> t, šć -> st, žđ -> zd), meeting objaviti/učiniti; 534 forms gained, 2 lost, weighted +0.36pp, over-stemming +0.04pp (participle adjective lemmas such as određen meeting their verb)

Passive participles, part 2: i-verbs whose root already ends in č/š/ž keep it before -en (završen, uključen, uložen, riješen, rečen), so a č/š/ž + en stem drops -en too; 0.90528, weighted +0.13pp, over-stemming +0.05pp. Adding d/s/t/z (doveden, donesen, korišten) scored up to 0.905515 but over-stemming +0.09-0.12pp from -en nouns and adjectives (jesen, bazen, leden, pošten)

-irati participles: -iran keeps its a (organizirana), so the fleeting-a step no longer turns it into -irn; -iran stems drop -an and meet organizir-ati/planir-ati; 198 forms gained, 1 lost (nemiran), weighted +0.09pp, over-stemming +0.10pp (11.78%), almost all participle adjective lemmas (planiran, definiran) meeting their verb

-nuti passive participles: the n-class verb rule stripped -ut/-uta/-uti/-uto but not the rest of the adjective paradigm, so spomenute/spomenutih/spomenutog stayed at spomenut while spomenuta went to spomen; added -ute/-utu/-utih/-utim/-utima/-utog/-utom/-utoj; 35 forms gained, 1 lost, adj +0.56pp, over-stemming unchanged

Passive participles, part 3: e-verbs in -sti/-ijeti keep the root dental after -e- (doveden, proveden, donesen, uvezen, pleten), so -eden/-esen/-ezen/-eten drop -en and meet dovede/donese; 28 forms gained, none lost, over-stemming +0.03pp (leden/meden/bezen adjectives). Researched and not kept: stemming -juć- participle adjectives like the bare gerund (0.90769, over-stemming +0.12pp) and ije->je jat normalization (0.907164, over-stemming +0.14pp)

Passive participles, part 4: i-verbs with a vowel+r root do not jotate (otvoren, stvoren, ostvaren, uvjeren, proširen), so -oren/-aren/-eren/-iren drop -en and meet otvoriti/ostvariti; 79 forms gained, 1 lost, weighted +0.06pp, over-stemming unchanged; plain -ren scored 0.909138 with +0.03pp

Passive participles, part 5: -oj- roots keep j (spojen, brojen, ustrojen -> spoj/broj) and vowel-root verbs insert -v- before -en (otkriven, pokriven, obuven -> otkr/pokr/ob, meeting otkrila/otkriti); +0.0007, weighted +0.03pp, over-stemming +0.01pp

Passive participles, part 6: -biti/-viti compounds insert -j- before -en (ubijen, dobijen, razbijen, razvijen), so -bijen/-vijen map to the b/v root and meet ubila/razvila; small: +0.00017, weighted +0.01pp, over-stemming unchanged; generic -ijen scored 0.909702 (korijen)

-tak nouns: the plural podaci/ostaci/zadaci loses the t (and #100 maps -aci to -ak), so a stem ending -atk drops the t (podatk -> podak), meeting the plural; 10 forms gained, none lost, weighted +0.02pp, over-stemming +0.004pp. -Cci plurals after other consonants (postupci, sastanci) are mostly -ac nouns (kupci, stranci) and were left alone

-aju regression from #88: rule .+(c|č|ž)aj u before the verb rules (-čaj/-caj/-žaj are noun suffixes: slučaju, utjecaju, položaju; 12 nouns gained) costs 7 a-verbs (pričaju, bacaju, pružaju) and verb consistency -0.33pp: score 0.909887 < 0.910121 though weighted +0.06pp. By type the -čaju/-caju/-žaju split is 12 noun vs 12 verb; by token it is 193 vs 29

-š- comparatives: a stem ending -kš/-pš drops the š (lakši/lakše/najlakše -> lak, mekši -> mek, ljepši -> ljep); 9 forms gained (lak +8), none lost, weighted +0.03pp, over-stemming unchanged; ljepši still misses lijep through the jat alternation

a-verb participles, -sati/-zati: they keep the a (napisana, povezana) where fleeting-a adjectives lose it (jasna), so a -san/-zan stem with a non-empty ending drops -an (napisan-a -> napis, povezan-og -> povez); bare napisan stays with fleeting-a (napisn) to protect jasan; +0.00064, weighted +0.03pp, over-stemming -0.01pp, adj -0.5pp (participle lemmas now split bare vs oblique). Adding -ran/-van scored up to 0.911428 but over-stemming +0.03pp and adj -1.5pp (ekran, Ivan, tiran)

a-verb participles, part 2: the oblique -an participle rule from #120 also covers -čan/-ćan/-žan/-šan/-han (održanom, uvećanog, pojačana, skuhan-a), where nouns with a stable -an are rare; +0.00054, weighted +0.04pp, over-stemming +0.02pp, adj -0.4pp. Adding -ivan/-ovan/-dan reached 0.911669 but over-stemming +0.04pp and adj -1.0pp

Fleeting a in -ak nouns: nominative postupak and genitive plural postupaka keep the a that postupka/postupku lose; a consonant+ak stem now becomes consonant+k with voicing assimilation (odlazak -> odlask, pritisak -> pritisk, zaključak -> zaključk). Stable-a nouns (korak) get -Ck in every form, so they stay consistent. -dak/-tak are skipped because they clashed with #117 (podaci); 70 forms gained, 2 lost, noun +0.7pp, weighted +0.13pp, over-stemming +0.04pp (nisk/niz, odmk/odmaći)

Fleeting a in -stvo genitive plurals: transformations C+stava -> C+stva for every consonant (ministarstava, svojstava, jamstava, sredstava, bogatstava), generalizing v0.1 nstava/kustava, plus -uštava (društava). After a vowel -stava is usually a verb or a stable-a noun (ostava, zaustava). A stem-level -stav -> -stv variant scored 0.911829 (postaviti/postava). Small: +0.00008, weighted +0.02pp, over-stemming unchanged

a-verb participles, part 3: oblique -ivan/-ovan participles (očekivana, imenovanog, uzrokovano) join the -iv stem #89 gives -ivati/-ovati verbs; 44 forms gained, 4 lost (osnovan, Radovan), +0.00047, weighted +0.02pp, over-stemming +0.02pp, adj -0.4pp (bare/oblique split). Researched and not committed: present gerund -eći/-ući stripping (0.912708 but over-stemming +0.06pp, adj -0.5pp) and loanword genitive plurals -akata/-epata/-nenata (+0.00007)

Fleeting a in -stan adjectives: the oblique forms lose the t too (koristan/korisna, svjestan/svjesna, izvrstan/izvrsna, bolestan/bolesna), so the fleeting-a step turns -stn into -sn; 10 forms gained, none lost, weighted +0.02pp, adj +0.3pp, over-stemming unchanged. A stem-level fleeting -ar/-av step (dobar/dobra, mrtav/mrtva) reached 0.913213 but over-stemming +0.04pp (rasprava/raspraviti, sudar/sudariti) and was not kept

Fleeting a in -tar/-bar/-dar: a final step turns stems ending -tar/-bar/-dar into -tr/-br/-dr (metar/metra, semestar, orkestar, vjetar, Petar, dobar/dobra, hrabar, mudar, Zadar), generalizing the v0.1 metara/centar/istar entries. Stable-a words get the same stem in every form; 27 forms gained, none lost, weighted +0.04pp, over-stemming +0.02pp (11.91%). -tar alone: 0.913002

Fleeting -ao: the masculine loses the l (posao -> pos, topao -> top, misao, okrugao, kotao, pakao) while the other forms keep it after a consonant (posla, topla, misli). The final step now drops a stem-final l after a consonant. a-verb participles have a vowel before the l (čekala) and are untouched. Also fixes -kl/-gl nouns lost in #93 (staklo, bicikl, kugla, magla). 51 forms gained, none lost, weighted +0.08pp, over-stemming +0.04pp (11.95%), mostly from the denominator (82 fewer stems; net +3 conflating). Only g/k/p/t: 0.913426

-ići compounds, masculine: transformations -ošao -> -ođe and -išao -> -iđe (došao, prošao, pošao, otišao, naišao) so the masculine meets dođe/došla at dod; the old stems (dos, pros, otis) were stray forms in other words' stems. -ašao/-ušao skipped (ponašao, pokušao); +0.0002, weighted +0.04pp, over-stemming flat

Passive participles, jotation st -> št (the ijekavian counterpart of šć): -šten maps back to -st (korišten, iskorišten, smješten, uvršten, napušten, obaviješten -> korist, smjest, ...), meeting koristiti/smjestiti; 43 forms gained, 1 lost, weighted +0.03pp, over-stemming -0.02pp

Velar -ći imperatives: the plural imperative sibilarizes k -> c (recite, recimo, povucite, izvucimo); transformations -ecite/-ecimo/-ucite/-ucimo -> -ek/-uk, which only verbs have (bare -eci stays for mjeseci); small: +0.00012, over-stemming flat. -aći infinitives read as -ađe scored -0.00002 (weighted +0.03pp) and were not kept

l-participle adjectives (ostali, nastali, preostali): the a-stem l-participle rule and the thematic-vowel endings gain -lih/-lim/-log/-loga/-loj/-lome/-lomu, so ostalih/ostalog meet ostala at ost; small: +0.00006, adj +0.13pp, weighted +0.04pp, over-stemming +0.01pp (denominator only, no new conflations)

Comparatives of participle adjectives: the -ij- strip now runs right after suffix stripping instead of returning early, and the naj- regular-comparative shortcut re-stems its positive, so kompliciraniji/najsloženiji/najtraženijih/laganiji go through the participle, -iran and fleeting-a steps like their positive (komplicir, slož, trag, lagn); 37 forms gained, 7 lost (najpoznatiji -> pozn), adj +0.62pp (94.88%, back above #119), over-stemming +0.01pp; without the naj- part 0.915049

Consistency between #103 and #127: #127 dropped the l of prošlog/prošlih (proš), while #103 maps prošla to prod. The l-drop step now maps vowel+šl to vowel+d as #103 does, so the adjective prošli and the -ići compound participles agree; 5 forms gained (prošli +3), none lost, weighted +0.03pp, over-stemming -0.01pp

Simplification: the #93 rule .+(k|g|š) la|li|lo|le is subsumed by #127 (stem-final consonant+l loses the l; vowel+šl maps to d), so it is removed; rekla/mogla/došla stem the same, and nouns it caught (igla, ugla) now keep their case forms together; +0.00006, over-stemming -0.01pp

Fleeting -ak, part 2: the #122 step now also covers -jak (ožujak, ponedjeljak, sastojak, odjeljak, ožiljak), and the #117 -atk step covers any vowel + tk (trenutak/trenuci, gubitak, postotak, zgoditak); 14 forms gained, none lost, weighted +0.02pp, over-stemming +0.01pp. Also removes the #103 -šl- step, which #127/#133 made dead code (no form changes)

Fleeting a in -ac nouns: a consonant+ac stem becomes consonant+c (kupac -> kupc like kupca/kupci, gen. pl. kupaca), generalizing the v0.1 per-consonant -nac/-mac/-vac/... transformations to every consonant; +0.00012, weighted +0.01pp, over-stemming flat. Adding -anj (lipanj/lipnja, svibanj) reached 0.915709 but over-stemming +0.02pp and was left out

H1 review fix: -ići compounds keep the palatal of their present. A vowel + šl stem left by a case/gender ending maps to vowel + đ (prošla/prošli/prošlog -> prođ, došla -> dođ, našli -> nađ, pošla -> pođ, izašla -> izađ), -ašao joins -ošao/-išao as -ađe (našao, izašao, pronašao), and đ->d depalatalization is dropped, so the paradigm no longer lands on prod/dod/nad/pod (prodati, dodati, nada). sl->šlj participles undo to sl (mišljen -> mis like misliti, was mid). Costs: mlađi/tvrđi no longer meet mlad/tvrd (-15 forms), ponašao/obnašao (2 forms); weighted -0.01pp, over-stemming -0.01pp

H2 review fix: single-consonant depalatalization (ž->g, č->k, š->s on stems of 5 letters or fewer) is removed. It merged palatal-root verbs, nouns and pronouns with unrelated velar/s stems (tražiti/traži -> trag, pokušati -> pokus, pružiti -> prug, održati -> odrg, pričam -> prik, naš/našeg -> nas, riječ -> rijek). Gating it on the stripped ending was measured and is worse than removing it: no ending separates traži from jači or naše from jače, so every gate that keeps jači->jak either keeps the trag merge or splits tražiti from traži (verbal gate alone 0.909215, comparative-only 0.910872). Costs: comparatives jači/duži/draži no longer meet jak/dug/drag and e-verb presents piše/pomaže/reče no longer meet pisati/pomagati/reći (145 forms). lakši -> lak (kš step) is unaffected. 30 fewer conflating stems, over-stemming -0.19pp, weighted -0.15pp

H3 review fix: restores the dative/locative -u that #88 took from the -aj noun rules, for -čaj/-caj/-žaj/-đaj (slučaju, utjecaju, položaju, uređaju, događaju, sadržaju, običaju, natječaju) and for -raj after a vowelless onset (kraju; traju now meets trajati). a-verb 3pl -čaju/-caju/-žaju/-đaju (pričaju, bacaju, pružaju, rađaju, sviđaju) lose their verb stem: 15 noun forms and traju gained (+336 tokens), 19 verb forms lost (-60 tokens); verb -0.80pp, weighted +0.09pp, over-stemming -0.02pp. beskraju still splits (its -raj follows a syllable, like igraju)

H4 review fix: the -je-/-ije- theme strip gets class checks. Long -ije- is thematic only after n/r in the infinitive (donijeti, umrijeti) and after n in the l-participle (donijela; umro/umrla), so podijeli/podijele, strijela, primijeti keep it. Short -je- is not stripped when the candidate ends in s (posjeti, podsjeti, prisjeti: the sjet- root) or is one verbal prefix plus a single consonant (sav-jet, za-vjet, po-djela, do-djela, raz-djela, pre-djel): savjeti -> savjet, podjela -> podjel, dodjela -> dodjel. vidjela/voljela/živjela/željela/uspjela/razumjela still strip; 10 forms gained, 1 lost (razumijeti), weighted +0.01pp, over-stemming -0.01pp

H5 review fix: the #105 soft genitive -eg/-ega leaves the unrestricted final catch-all. It is stripped after a palatal or j (našeg, općeg, nečega, boljeg, posljednjeg, kojeg, svojeg, dječjeg), and -ijeg only with a syllable before -ij (starijeg, not snijeg/bijeg/brijeg). After other consonants it is a noun: kolega -> koleg (was kol = kolo), snijeg/snijega -> snijeg (was snij), brijeg -> brijeg, bubreg -> bubreg, opseg -> opseg; 13 forms gained, 1 lost (čijeg), šireg 5 tokens; weighted +0.01pp, over-stemming -0.01pp

H6 review fix: syllabic r is an r between consonants or word-initial before a consonant, not a stem-final r after a consonant, so broj/stroj/zbroj/kroj keep -oj (was br/str/zbr/kr = brati, strah) and drama/droga/prima no longer lose their vowel to dr/pr. The four bare [aeiou] checks (fleeting -ak, -ac, -tar, -ao) use _has_vowel with the r judged in the whole stem: cvrčak -> cvrčk like cvrčka, vršak -> vršk, mrtvac/mrtvacu -> mrtvc, smrzao/smrzla -> smrz. The short infinitive -t needs a root vowel before the thematic a: brat/vrat keep -at (was bra/vra = brati, vratiti). 12 forms gained (+212 tokens), 4 lost (tri/triju/trima, znat, fra); weighted +0.07pp, over-stemming -0.01pp

Optional review fix: the -ovati/-ivati and -uj- -> -iv mapping requires a root of three letters with a vowel before the suffix (one helper for both branches), so struja/struju/struje stay struj (struju/struje were striv); 2 forms gained, none lost, over-stemming flat

Optional review fix: -dak nouns alternate like -tak ones (pogodak/pogotka/pogoci, napredak/napretka, dohodak/dohotka), so a vowel + dak stem of six letters or more reads as vowel + tk and goes through the -tk step (napredak -> naprek like napretka, pogodak -> pogok like pogotka/pogoci, sladak/slatka -> slatk); the short stems the -aci plural leaves (podak, zadak) are untouched. The dead d->t entry in _DEVOICE is removed. 10 forms gained, none lost, weighted +0.02pp, over-stemming +0.01pp (denominator only: 8 fewer stems, no new conflating stem). gubici/počeci (-ici/-eci plurals of -tak nouns) left alone: bare -ici/-eci is mostly stranici/mjeseci

Optional review fix: the .+ozil noun rule takes -o too (vozilo -> vozil like vozila/vozilu, was voz = voziti). The rule already claims -a/-e/-i, which -oziti l-participles share, so -o follows the same reading: izvozilo/uvozilo/zgrozilo leave their verb (4 verb forms lost, 1 noun form gained by type, +5 tokens); one fewer conflating stem
